output.description: A fully branded Canvas document, a direct link to the generated PDF format, and a PowerPoint-ready structural outline.

parameters.name: customer_url
parameters.description: The customer website URL for branding

parameters.name: average_order_value_or_lead_value
parameters.description: The customer AOV or lead value

parameters.name: developer_time_saved_hours
parameters.description: Estimated dev hours saved per month

parameters.name: developer_hourly_cost
parameters.description: Cost of developer time per hour

parameters.name: value_of_time_to_market
parameters.description: Estimated value gained from faster time to market

description: Create a high-quality, customer-branded ROI report that demonstrates the financial and operational value of increasing testing velocity.
prompt_template:
**Goal:**\
Create a high-quality, customer-branded ROI report that demonstrates the financial and operational value of increasing testing velocity using Web Experimentation and Opal AI.

**Role:**\
Act as a Strategic Value Consultant and Data Analyst. Calculate accurate ROI based on provided customer inputs and fixed benchmark data.

**Action:**

1. Browse `[[customer_url]]` to identify their brand guidelines.
2. Use `browse_web` to scan benchmarks for reference purposes at <https://www.optimizely.com/insights/the-2025-optimizely-opal-ai-benchmark-report/> and <https://www.optimizely.com/no/insights/pillar-pages/127000-experiments-lessons-to-level-up-your-program/>
3. Calculate projected ROI showing exact math. Do not hallucinate any numbers or math.
4. Draft the report including: Why increasing testing velocity creates compounding value, with the quote 'With Opal AI we see an average increase in test volume of 78.7%', and a clear breakdown of metrics.
5. Output directly into the canvas in an A4 layout using `create_canvas`
6. Output the entire output using `convert_to_pdf`.

**Output:**\
A fully branded Canvas document, PDF format link, and PPT-ready structural outline.

**Guardrails:**\
Do not hallucinate. All mathematics must tie back to inputs/benchmarks. Prioritise customer brand elements.

**Instructions:**\
Follow the defined workflow and adhere to the guardrails. Use `[[customer_url]]`, `[[average_order_value_or_lead_value]]`, `[[developer_time_saved_hours]]`, `[[developer_hourly_cost]]`, `[[value_of_time_to_market]]`, and `[[current_tests_per_year]]`.
